heading: Independent by design.
Fiduciary by commitment.
lede: Founded in 2010, Vann Equity Management is an independent, SEC-registered investment advisory firm built on a single principle: the client's interest comes first. So strong is our commitment that we have adopted fiduciary standards across the entire firm.

We manage multiple equity and tactical asset-allocation portfolios for high-net-worth individuals, institutions, endowments, foundations, and family offices — each guided by the same disciplined, proprietary process.

vision.quote: We combine the intellectual rigor of institutional investing with the personal accountability of a boutique firm. Our goal is straightforward — protect, grow, and deliver on the trust our clients place in us, quarter after quarter, year after year.
